purpose: Admit a numeric national 2026 point only through a historically selected forecasting rule; current-only political evidence cannot alter the point by judgement.

incremental_input_admission.rule: An information class may affect the numeric 2026 point only after a frozen transformation using the same class before historical target elections demonstrably improves out-of-sample national forecast skill.

required_fields.as_of: ISO-8601 cutoff strictly before the election outcome
required_fields.point_share: strictly positive nine-bucket vector summing exactly to one within numerical tolerance
required_fields.model: winner of the frozen rolling-origin tournament
required_fields.evidence: versioned historical inputs + frozen model-selection output

downstream.final_probability_gate: national point + national uncertainty + conditional geography residuals + legal allocator + rolling-origin coverage + >=50000 valid simulations
